items.title: File Widerspruch against rehab benefits rejection
items.quote: Erheben Sie ihn binnen eines Monats nach Bekanntgabe schriftlich oder zur Niederschrift bei der Muster-Rentenversicherung Nordwest.
items.computation: Letter dated Tuesday 11.03.2025, sent by post. Under § 37 Abs. 2 SGB X a letter is deemed delivered on the 3rd day after posting; 11.03.2025 + 3 days = Friday 14.03.2025, which is a normal business day in NRW (no weekend/holiday adjustment needed), so Bekanntgabe = 14.03.2025. The one-month Widerspruch period runs under §§ 26 SGB X, 187 Abs. 1, 188 Abs. 2 BGB: the day of Bekanntgabe (14.03.2025) is not counted, the period starts 15.03.2025, and ends on the day of the following month that numerically corresponds to the event day (14th) = 14.04.2025. 14.04.2025 is a Monday and not a public holiday in NRW, so no further shift is needed.
